title: Yellow Light: Stop if You Can Do So Safely
section: Section 7 · Traffic Signals · Solid Yellow Light
intro: You are approaching the signal. There is enough space to brake smoothly before the line.
watchCaption: Green changes to yellow. The limit line is still ahead.
safeCaption: Smooth braking brings you to a stop before the line.
unsafeCaption: The light turns red as you reach the intersection.
safeFeedback: You brake while there is room and stop just before the limit line.

feedback.accelerate: You continued into the intersection as the light turned red. Braking on yellow would have kept you clear.
feedback.late-brake: Waiting used up your stopping distance. Hard braking left your car past the line.
